Overview

ModAE’s OverSpeed Detection Systems are designed to safeguard critical rotating machinery by monitoring and controlling speed conditions, preventing catastrophic equipment failure due to overspeed events. These systems ensure the safe operation of turbines and other high-speed equipment by employing advanced sensors and real-time control mechanisms to quickly detect and mitigate overspeed scenarios.

Key Features

  • SIL-Rated Speed Sensors
    Utilizes SIL3-rated sensors conforming to ANSI/ISA and IEC standards, ensuring reliable speed measurement and control in high-demand safety applications. The sensors offer high precision and can operate in harsh conditions, providing robust protection in critical scenarios.
  • Real-Time Speed Monitoring
    Continuously monitors the rotational speed of machinery, providing instant feedback to control systems. This allows for rapid response and intervention to prevent damage from reaching critical levels.
  • Automated Shutdown Mechanism
    Equipped with an automated shutdown function that activates when unsafe speed limits are detected. This immediate response protects both the equipment and surrounding systems from potential damage or failure.
  • Environmental Durability
    Designed to operate in extreme temperatures and challenging environments, the systems maintain high reliability even in harsh industrial conditions, ensuring consistent performance.

Applications

Ideal for high-speed rotating machinery such as turbines in power plants, oil & gas, and heavy industrial sectors.

Benefits

  • Prevents catastrophic equipment failures by detecting and controlling overspeed conditions.
  • Enhances machinery safety and operational reliability.
  • Meets stringent safety standards, ensuring compliance with industry regulations.
  • Reduces downtime and maintenance costs associated with overspeed events.

Related Services

  • Project Engineering and Management: Complete solution for over speed control system installation or upgrade starting form providing specification, carrying out detailed design and engineering and project management services
  • Installation and Calibration: Expert installation and fine-tuning of sensors and control systems.
  • Lifecycle Support and Maintenance: Regular checks, doing calibrations and maintenance to ensure system accuracy and reliability.
  • Training and Skill Development: Training operators in the effective use and management of overspeed protection systems.

Overview

ModAE’s Antisurge Control Systems are designed to protect compressors from dangerous surge conditions that can cause severe damage to turbomachinery. By continuously monitoring the compressor’s operating point and modulating a recycle or blow-off valve, these systems maintain stable operations while preventing surges and ensuring the compressor stays within safe operating limits.

Key Features

  • Surge Detection and Prevention
    Utilizes advanced algorithms to calculate the distance between the operating point and the surge limit, automatically adjusting valves to maintain stability. This ensures the compressor does not reach surge conditions, minimizing the risk of equipment damage.
  • Precise Control with Reduced Margins
    Integrates closed and open-loop control responses to provide precise control without requiring large control margins, thereby minimizing unnecessary recycling and maximizing efficiency.
  • Adaptable Configurations
    Designed to handle a wide range of compressor applications, from single-stage to multi-section compressors, and adaptable to varying process conditions, including changes in molecular weight and compressor geometry.
  • Coordinated Control
    Supports integration with performance control systems to optimize overall compressor operation, allowing for coordinated load sharing and balancing across multiple compressors operating in parallel.

Applications

Suitable for centrifugal and axial compressors used in various industries such as power generation, petrochemicals, and oil & gas, ensuring safe and efficient compressor operation.

Benefits

  • Prevents costly damage to compressors by keeping operations within safe limits.
  • Enhances system stability and reliability, reducing unplanned shutdowns.
  • Minimizes process disruptions with smooth and automated valve control.
  • Supports flexible configurations for diverse compressor applications.

Related Services

  • Project Engineering and Management: Complete solution for control system installation or upgrade starting form providing specification, carrying out detailed design and engineering and project management services
  • Installation and Commissioning: Setup and fine-tuning of antisurge control systems for precise performance.
  • System Integration and Configuration: Tailored configurations to meet specific compressor requirements.
  • Lifecycle Support and Maintenance: Regular checks, calibrations and maintenance to ensure system accuracy and reliability
  • Training and Support: Training programs for operators to effectively manage antisurge control systems.

Overview

ModAE’s Turbine Control Systems provide precise control and monitoring solutions for various turbine applications, including gas, steam, and hydro turbines. These systems are designed to optimize turbine performance, ensure safe operation, and enhance production efficiency. With advanced control capabilities, they deliver rapid response to changing load conditions, minimizing risks like overspeed and unstable operations.

Key Features

  • Comprehensive Control Solutions: ModAE’s systems include integrated solutions such as governing system controlling steam, fuel and air flow controls including guide vane actuators, and control modules, providing precise control over all turbine parameters. This ensures smooth start-up, efficient load management, and reliable shutdown procedures.
  • Rapid and smooth Response with Reliability: Our systems are engineered for fast but smooth response and they prevent overspeed conditions and manage rapid load changes, ensuring grid stability and reducing operational risks.
  • .Multi-Fuel Capability:  Supports a variety of fuels, including natural gas, hydrogen, and low-carbon alternatives, enabling flexible operations and supporting decarbonization initiatives in power generation.
  • Triple-Modular Redundancy: Designed with triple-redundancy for critical functions, our turbine control systems ensure the highest levels of safety and reliability, preventing single-point failures that could disrupt operations.
  • Cybersecurity Features: Equipped with robust cybersecurity protocols to protect critical control systems from external threats, ensuring safe and secure operations in all environments.

Applications

ModAE’s Turbine Control Systems are widely used in power generation applications, including gas turbines, steam turbines, and hydro turbines. They are ideal for both peaking and base-load power plants, providing safe and efficient control for various energy production needs.

Benefits

  • Optimizes turbine performance and efficiency across a wide range of operating conditions.
  • Reduces the risk of costly unplanned outages by ensuring stable and reliable operations.
  • Enhances grid stability through fast response to load changes and varying demands.
  • Supports flexible fuel options, allowing operators to adapt to different fuel sources.

Related Services

  • Project Engineering and Management: Complete solution for control system installation or upgrade starting form providing specification, carrying out detailed design and engineering and project management services
  • Installation and Commissioning: End-to-end support for deploying turbine control systems.
  • Lifecycle Support, upgrades and Maintenance: Regular checks and maintenance to ensure system accuracy and reliability. Providing upgrades to enhance functionality and overcome obsolescence issues as well as meeting newer technology requirements
  • System Upgrades and Maintenance: Upgrades to enhance functionality and support new fuel sources.
  • Condition Monitoring and Diagnostics: Ongoing monitoring and diagnostics of control valves to maintain system reliability.
  • Training and Skill Development: Comprehensive training programs for operators and engineers.

Overview

ModAE’s Machinery Diagnostics solutions offer advanced tools and software for assessing the condition of rotating equipment. Using real-time data, advanced algorithms, and expert analysis, these solutions identify root causes of issues, optimize equipment performance, and recommend corrective actions. The diagnostics cover critical machinery and components, helping to maintain safe and reliable operations.

Key Features

  • Comprehensive Condition Assessment
    Our solutions analyze key parameters like vibration, temperature, and rotor dynamics to detect early signs of wear, misalignment, or imbalances, or any other malfunction thus enabling timely detection and intervention.
  • Root Cause Analysis
    By using historical data trends and diagnostics algorithms, the systems helps our expert engineers or plant personnel in identifying underlying issues, such as lubrication deficiencies, misalignment, or structural problems, and pinpoint the exact cause of machinery malfunction.
  • Predictive Maintenance Planning
    Supports data-driven maintenance planning by providing accurate insights into machinery health. This enables maintenance teams to prioritize actions, reducing unplanned downtime and optimizing the use of resources.
  • Real-Time Diagnostic Alerts
    Delivers real-time alerts when machinery operates outside of defined thresholds, allowing maintenance teams to take immediate corrective actions, preventing potential damage or failure.

Applications

Ideal for monitoring and diagnosing equipment such as turbines, pumps, compressors, generators, motors etc or in general terms this can cater to rotating and reciprocating machines in power plants, oil and gas facilities, and petrochemical industries.

Benefits

  • Minimizes unplanned downtimes and maintenance costs by detecting issues early.
  • Extends machinery lifespan through timely maintenance and corrective actions.
  • Improves overall operational safety and reliability.
  • Enhances decision-making with in-depth analysis and reporting.

Related Services

  • Installation and Commissioning: Setting up diagnostic systems for maximum accuracy and efficiency.
  • Condition Monitoring and Support: Ongoing monitoring support to maintain high performance and reliability.
  • Remote Diagnostics: Cloud-enabled remote diagnostics to support safe operations and minimize disruptions.

Overview

ModAE’s Asset Health Management (AHM) solutions provide industry-leading tools for maintaining the reliability, availability and performance of critical machinery across energy sectors. By combining real-time data acquisition, advanced analytics, and intuitive visualization, these systems deliver a complete overview of equipment health, ensuring timely intervention and minimizing unplanned outages.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Monitoring
    Our AHM solutions continuously track key parameters such as vibration, temperature, positions, Speed and process parameters customized for specific applications, enabling immediate detection of abnormal conditions. This real-time data stream allows maintenance teams to respond proactively, preventing minor issues from escalating into major breakdowns.
  • Enhanced Connectivity
    Integrated systems offer seamless connectivity between asset health monitoring and maintenance execution, ensuring data flows efficiently across the organization. This connectivity supports better resource allocation, coordinated maintenance efforts, and faster response times.
  • Advanced Analytics
    Leveraging cutting-edge analytics, our AHM systems transform raw data into actionable insights. By combining historical trends, root cause analysis, related inputs and predictive algorithms, we help clients make informed decisions about asset performance and maintenance planning.
  • Visualizations and Reporting
    Our solutions offer clear visual representations of asset conditions, including dashboards, trend charts, and custom reports. These visual tools help prioritize maintenance actions, allocate resources effectively, and provide comprehensive overviews of asset health for stakeholders.
  • Scalable Solutions
    From single machines to plant-wide coverage, ModAE’s AHM systems are designed to scale. Whether it’s a standalone unit or an enterprise-level solution, our systems grow with operational needs, ensuring continuous support as asset portfolios expand.

Applications

ModAE’s Asset Health Management solutions are ideal for power plants, oil & gas facilities, and petrochemical industries. They are used to track the condition of rotating equipment, turbines, pumps, and compressors, in general catering to rotating and reciprocating machines and   providing a unified platform for maintaining optimal performance and extending asset lifespans.

Benefits

  • Increases operational efficiency by reducing unplanned outages and optimizing maintenance schedules.
  • Minimizes maintenance costs by identifying and resolving issues before they impact performance.
  • Extends asset life and maximizes uptime by providing continuous oversight and early warnings.
  • Enhances safety and compliance by ensuring equipment operates within prescribed parameters.
  • Supports enterprise-wide visibility, offering a unified view of all critical assets.

Related Services

  • Project Engineering and Management:  Complete solution right from writing specification, carrying out detailed design and engineering and project management services
  • Installation and Commissioning: Complete support for deploying asset health management systems.
  • Condition Monitoring and Diagnostics: Advanced diagnostics to assess asset condition and recommend corrective actions.
  • Remote Monitoring: Continuous monitoring from remote locations for enhanced safety and efficiency.
  • Training and Skill Development: Training programs for maintenance teams on effective AHM system utilization.

Overview

ModAE provides a range of sophisticated monitoring systems designed to ensure the safety, reliability, and performance of critical rotating equipment in energy sectors. These systems offer plant-wide machinery monitoring and comprehensive asset protection, allowing clients to optimize operations and achieve long-term equipment health. With capabilities for real-time data acquisition, early fault detection, and seamless integration, ModAE’s monitoring solutions enable clients to enhance productivity and prevent costly downtimes.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Condition Monitoring
    Continuously captures essential parameters such as vibration, temperature, and position, enabling round-the-clock visibility of machinery health. Early anomaly detection allows for prompt intervention, minimizing the risk of equipment failure.
  • Predictive Maintenance Planning
    Leverages advanced data analytics to predict potential faults, enabling proactive scheduling of maintenance activities. This reduces unexpected shutdowns and extends machinery lifespan, resulting in higher availability and reduced maintenance costs.
  • Scalable and Modular Design
    Our systems are designed to adapt to both small and large-scale operations. With modular components, clients can start with a basic setup and expand the system as their requirements grow, ensuring that their monitoring system evolves with their business.
  • Customizable Alarm Management
    Configurable alarms and thresholds tailored to various operational conditions help in identifying critical changes in machinery status. This ensures that maintenance teams are alerted in time and can implement corrective actions promptly.
  • Multi-Channel and Distributed Monitoring
    Supports multi-channel monitoring of several machines simultaneously, providing centralized control over machinery health across different units. Distributed systems reduce wiring costs and offer flexibility in remote or complex setups.
  • Remote Access and Cloud Integration
    Offers secure remote access and cloud integration, allowing monitoring and diagnostics to be performed from anywhere. This is particularly beneficial for remote locations or hazardous environments, as it minimizes the need for on-site personnel.

Applications

ModAE’s monitoring systems are essential in power generation facilities (thermal, nuclear, hydro), oil & gas plants, and petrochemical industries. They are widely used for monitoring turbines, compressors, pumps, and other critical rotating equipment to track and ensure operational efficiency and safety.

Benefits

  • Prevents unexpected equipment failures by providing continuous data and early warning signals.
  • Enhances plant safety by identifying abnormal conditions before they escalate.
  • Reduces maintenance costs by enabling condition-based maintenance planning.
  • Extends machinery life through comprehensive asset health management.
  • Supports high asset availability, ensuring maximum productivity.

Related Services

Overview

ModAE offers a comprehensive range of industrial sensors for real-time condition monitoring and protection of critical rotating equipment in energy systems. These sensors are crucial for early detection of mechanical issues, enabling condition-based and predictive maintenance. From detecting vibrations, temperature, Speed, Positions (axial shifts, thermal expansions and differential Expansions etc) our sensors are most reliable and ensure maximum uptime and performance of critical assets by avoiding false detection on one side and sensing abnormal parameters thus reducing operational risks.

Key Features

  • Proximity Sensors: Measure rotor shaft position and vibration, ideal for rotating machinery.
  • Velocity Sensors & Accelerometers: Used for measuring acceleration, velocity, and seismic activity, with applications ranging in all kinds of turbomachinery in order to meet machinery protection needs. These sensors are designed for harsh environment as well, so as to meet the requirement for specific machinery 
  • Wireless Vibration Sensors: Provide condition monitoring for hard-to-reach locations, with long battery life and remote data access. This improves data quality as well as productivity of condition monitoring team
  • Hydro & Nuclear Application Sensors: Captures multiple variables, providing insights into vibration issues in hydroelectric generators, turbines and specially designed for nuclear application.
  • Transmitters: Suitable range of vibration, thrust and position measurement transmitters are offered to meet any specific requirement.

Applications

These sensors are widely used in power plants (thermal, nuclear, hydro, and gas), oil & gas facilities, and petrochemical industries. They are essential for measuring the parameters such as vibration, temperature, positions, speed etc. to assess the condition of rotating equipment such as turbines, pumps, compressors and other critical machinery.

Benefits

  • This is the key element for protection of the machinery from any significant damage or equipment failure
  • Enables proactive maintenance by providing real-time data and early warning signals
  • Reduces unplanned downtime and avoids soaring maintenance costs by detecting anomalies early.
  • Supports efficient plant operations by optimizing asset health and extending the life of machinery.

Related Services

  • Project Engineering and Management:  Complete solution right from writing specification, carrying out detailed design and engineering and project management services
  • Installation and Commissioning: Professional installation, calibration and integration with machinery protection and monitoring systems.
  • Life Cycle Support: Providing calibration check, on-condition replacement during major overhauls of the equipment by our highly skilled engineers, ensuring high reliability and upkeep of the sensors and protection systems. Suggesting necessary  upgrades for sensor systems as and where applicable.
  • Remote Monitoring: Using Cloud-based machinery management platforms using  continuous data collected by sensors and doing analysis.
